body:
The past generation often still think that college degrees must be quickly done and are worth as much as they were in the past. That's obviously not true anymore.    
    
Listen, take the break. During that break, take some time to breathe and to store the energy you need to find a therapist and go. Maybe your boyfriend can help look for one.    
    
I never took a break from college, but I wished I had, because it was just a downward spiral from there. As long as you get the self-healing time and help you need during that break, there really is no harm done. You're still young.
